title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Can't find what you're looking for?
support: Ask your question in the community.

items.question: How do I join the Malagasy community in Germany?
items.answer: Create a free account with your email or your Google account. You can then join communities (by city or theme), post, comment, send private messages, and browse job offers and property listings.

items.question: How do I post a job offer or apply?
items.answer: Post your offer from the "Jobs" section. Candidates apply directly from the offer or through the external link provided by the employer.

items.question: Can I offer housing or look for a flatshare?
items.answer: Yes. The "Real estate" section accepts rental, flatshare and temporary housing listings, with photos and location.

items.question: I'm a service provider, how can I showcase my business?
items.answer: Create your free page from the "Providers" section: services, prices, photos of your work and WhatsApp or social media contacts.

items.question: Are there posting limits?
items.answer: To keep the community high-quality and prevent abuse, the number of posts each member can publish over time is limited (communities, job offers, property listings). These limits may change, and you will see a message when you reach them.

items.question: Is Hallomada paid?
items.answer: No. All the essentials stay free: browsing listings and job offers, contacting, applying, private messaging and taking part in communities. A Premium subscription at €4.90 per month exists to go further, and it is currently offered to all members.

items.question: Why a single subscription, whether I am looking or publishing?
items.answer: Because on Hallomada, looking and publishing are two moments in the life of the same member. Take Ali: in January, he is looking for a room in Berlin and sends his rental application file in one click. He finds one. In June, he sublets that same room for the summer and his listing is reviewed first. The following year, his company is hiring and he publishes the offer. Same Ali, same subscription: Premium helps him find faster, then be more visible.

items.question: I am only looking for housing or a job. Is Premium useful to me?
items.answer: Yes. Premium helps you get there first and stand out: a rental application file ready to send in one click, view statistics and priority moderation, with highlighted job applications and listing bumps coming soon. Some features are rolling out gradually.

items.question: Why are some Premium benefits marked "Coming soon"?
items.answer: We are building them one by one. They will be enabled for all Premium members as soon as they are ready, with nothing for you to do.

items.question: What happens when Premium becomes paid?
items.answer: We will let you know in advance. The essentials will stay free, and you can keep using Hallomada on the Free plan with its limits, or choose Premium.

items.question: How do I get the Founding member badge?
items.answer: It goes to the first 100 members whose real estate listing or job offer is approved by moderation. Each badge has a number ("Founder no. 23") and is kept for life. It appears on your profile, listings and job offers.

items.question: How do I report inappropriate content?
items.answer: Use the report option available on posts, comments, job offers and listings. Administrators review every report and can remove the content concerned.

items.question: Is the platform open to Malagasy people back home?
items.answer: Yes. Our mission is to build a bridge between Malagasy people in Germany and those who stayed in Madagascar. Anyone can sign up, and the site is available in French, German and English.

items.question: Is my personal data secure?
items.answer: We comply with the GDPR. Visit statistics are only enabled with your consent, which you can change at any time via "Manage cookies". See our privacy policy for details.

items.question: How can I contact the team?
items.answer: Write to us from the Contact page, or ask your question in the community. The legal notice and terms of use are available from the footer.
